body: OCR, layout analysis, reading order, table recognition in 90+ languages
plain_description: **Turn documents into searchable, structured information.** Extract text from PDFs and images, understand page layout and reading order, and convert tables into HTML. Supports more than 90 languages.
technical_description: Surya is a 689M-parameter document OCR and layout vision-language model. It performs OCR, layout analysis, reading-order detection, and table recognition, returning structured blocks with labels, coordinates, confidence, and HTML. It runs through vLLM, llama.cpp, or an opt-in MLX backend; the package can start an inference server automatically or connect to an existing OpenAI-compatible server. An interactive browser viewer is included.
title: Surya
